SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 8229
Section 1, Special Branch Shanghai
REPORT
Date December 6, 1937.
Subject Recruiting Russian labour for the Japanese occupied area.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by C Crawford S.I.

（批：Try and see / 8/12 / 7/12）
（批：P.A. / Gp 7 / C & P.W.）
（批：cp）
（印：- 6 DEC 1937）
（批：C & P.W. / might be / interested?）

Information from reliable sources indicates that a Japanese merchant who has secured from the local Japanese military authorities a contract for cleaning streets etc. in the Japanese occupied districts of the Settlement, recruits Russian labour for this purpose through the medium of his partner, a certain Italian named F.U. Denticl. The wages offered are $ 3.50 per day. So far about 200 men are reported to have been recruited and the work is expected to start in a few days time.

Denticl who is reported to be a person of a doubtful reputation, resides at 1218 Rue Lafayette, House 2. At that address he engaged about 150 men apparently, without any consideration as to their characters etc. Later he secured the assistance of a Russian named N.U. Golinetz as a foreman and recruiting agent. The latter individual is a member of the S.M.I. (Specials). He is unemployed at present and resides at the Russian Club, 1053 Avenue Foch, where Russian refugees from the area north of the Soochow creek are now accomodated.

According to Golinetz he has recruited 50 Russians to form the first group and is at present engaged in the recruiting additional 200 men. When taking over this job from Denticl he insisted that only men who are duly registered with the Russian Emigrants' Committee should be engaged and that no individuals with criminal records etc. be allowed to join. The Russian Emigrants' Committee charges 10 cents for registration in this connection.

It is also reported that certain Russian organizations including the All-Russia Fascist Party, Russian National Union, Union of Former Members of Ataman Semenoff's Special Detachment

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号 8229
上海特别课第一组
报告
日期：1937年12月6日。
主题：为日军占领区招募俄国劳工。
呈报人：D.S. Tcheremshansky。转呈人：C Crawford，巡官。

（批注：Try and see / 12月8日 / 12月7日）
（批注：P.A. / 第7组 / C & P.W.）
（批注：cp）
（印章：- 1937年12月6日）
（批注：C & P.W. / 可能 / 感兴趣？）

据可靠消息来源称，一名日本商人从当地日本军方当局获得了在租界内日军占领区清扫街道等工作的合同，并通过其合伙人、一名名为 F.U. Denticl 的意大利人作为中介，为此目的招募俄国劳工。提供的工资为每天3.50元。据悉，迄今已招募约200人，预计工作将于数日内开始。

据报道，Denticl 名声不佳，居住于拉斐特路（Rue Lafayette）1218号2室。在该地址，他显然未对人员品行等进行任何审查，便雇佣了约150人。随后，他获得了一名名为 N.U. Golinetz 的俄国人的协助，担任工头及招募代理人。此人是上海义勇队（S.M.I.，即 Specials）成员。他目前失业，居住在福煦路（Avenue Foch）1053号的俄国俱乐部，苏州河以北地区的俄国难民现安置于此。

据 Golinetz 称，他已招募50名俄国人组成第一批队伍，目前正着手再招募200人。他在从 Denticl 手中接手这项工作时坚持认为，只应雇佣已在俄国侨民委员会正式登记的人员，且不得允许有犯罪记录等劣迹的个人加入。俄国侨民委员会为此项登记收取10美分费用。

另有报告称，包括全俄法西斯党、俄罗斯民族联盟、前阿塔曼·谢苗诺夫（Ataman Semenoff）满洲特别分队（OKO）成员联盟等某些俄国组织
